title: decision.json: Krish's recorded decisions for one run (docs/RUN.md, docs/CONCEPT-MANIFEST.md)
description: Written only from the readback of his Control Center decisions (engine/run/decision.py for the concept part). The go-live part is proposal_id, decision, decided_at, slots and amended; the concept part is concepts, concept_proposal_id, concept_decision, concept_hold, concept_manifest, concept_daily_caps, stopped_concepts and changed_concepts. A concept-only decision has proposal_id and decision null and slots {}.

proposal_id.description: The week's go-live proposal, or null when the decision is concept-only.

decision.description: approved for a go-live decision; null when concept-only.

slots.description: slot_id to the 64-hex digest Krish signed one by one; {} when concept-only.

amended.description: Optional; slot_id to Krish's amended payload.

concepts.description: concept_id to its 64-hex concept_sha256, approved in the week's mix plan; the spec signature's concepts_digest is the sha256 of this map's canonical JSON.

concept_proposal_id.description: The mix plan proposal for the run's ISO week; equals the spec signature's concept_proposal_id.

concept_decision.description: His latest recorded decision on the week's mix plan as the run read it; null when none is recorded. held means his amended version changed plan terms the engine cannot enforce, so nothing is approved.

concept_hold.description: null, or why no concept is approved this run (a code first: stop_unresolved, amended_plan_terms, stale_approval, plan_untrusted, not_applied). While it is set, concepts is {} and no derived post releases.

concept_manifest.description: Each approved concept in full, one entry per key of concepts; concept_sha256 recomputes from the other fields (engine/concepts.py concept_payload).

concept_daily_caps.description: channel to the scheduled posts a New York day may carry on it, counted across every run, read when this file was written; release enforces the live cap and an executor never exceeds either.

stopped_concepts.description: Concept ids Krish stopped: deleted or changed in his amended plan, or every concept when he declined it. A stop never lifts.

changed_concepts.description: The stopped concepts whose line he edited; the next plan reads his words.
